title: Lemongrass Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African stew originating from Morocco, perfect for a cold evening meal.
instructions: 1. Heat the oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium-high heat.
2. Add the chicken to the tagine and sear until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
3. Add the chicken broth, tomatoes, spice blend, salt, and pepper to the tagine.
4. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
5. Garnish with fresh lemongrass and serve over couscous or rice.
